newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber buys Haikou tyre plant.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber buys Haikou tyre plant.

text.p: Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co Ltd has signed a contract to take over bankrupt state-owned Haikou Tyre Factory with annual production capacity of 450,000 tyres, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
Shanghai Tyre paid 14.637 million yuan for the Haikou plant, which stopped production in August with accumulated losses of more than 100 million yuan, it said.

The Haikou plant has total fixed assets, including land, of 67.687 million yuan but 53.05 million yuan was needed for the cost of looking after the plant's workers, making Shanghai Tyre's payment 14.637 million yuan, the newspaper said.
It did not say who would pay for looking after the plant's workers.

Founded in 1958, the Haikou plant posted a net loss of 22.16 million yuan in the first seven months of the year despite a turnover of 15.4 million yuan and industrial output value of 24.13 million, the Business News said.
The takeover was the largest by a Shanghai firm of a company outside the city, the Shanghai Securities News said. Haikou is the capital of Hainan province.

After the takeover, the Shanghai firm plans to resume production at the Haikou plant and bring it back to output of 450,000 tyres a year, rising to 600,000 by the year 2000, the newspaper said but gave no more details.
